One released matching sample establishes baseline; two subsequent increasing polls are required with continued expectation. Missing ACK, errors, no progress, regression, stale focus or lost identity cannot be accepted. No Night poll-reset proof is imported.

Existing five menuTap markers were previously ignored on Android; this candidate activates them as documented, as well as the six corrected Y steps. All driving steps stay on the exact old held-input path.
